data.summary:
Total 13+ years’ experience and 11+ years in IT Primarily in Functional Consultant in SAP Plant Maintenance and Quality Management in Manufacturing, Automotive, Health Care, and Chemical.
Involved in 5 End-to-End Implementations, Migration, Rollout and 6 support Projects.
Worked on the SAP ECC6.0 EHP7, S4 HANA 1511, 1809, 2020, 2023 version.
Worked on Fiori applications in PM/QM Modules and involved in Authorization Matrix.
Understanding the client Business Requirement & preparation of BBP, To Be, KDS, GAP Analysis documentation.
Conducted workshops on various phases of project like BBP phase, master data validation phase with CTMs and End users.
Creation of End user and Core user training material using different tools like TTKF, HPALM and conducting workshops.
Maintenance Processing such as Operational functions, Notification, Order & Planning, Scheduling and Completion.
Planning & Execution of Maintenance plan Preventive with Time and Performance Based Plans.
Scheduling the Maintenance Plans with Deadline Monitoring and Call Object generation.
Implemented the Business Process Breakdown, Corrective, Sub-Orders, Calibration, Capital/Improvement, Refurbishment, Shutdown Maintenance Process.
Experience in the Z reports and creating the Functional specification documents.
Developed a KPI and reports i.e., Breakdown, Cost analysis, Damage, Statics (Functional Location and Equipment) wise.
Involved in collecting QM Master Data MIC, Sampling Procedure for Calibration Process.
Generation of Inspection lot, Results recording, user decisions, and collecting the Catalog Master data for the same.
Creations of Unit test, Integration test scripts and conducting testing for the same.
End user manual, Configuration document Preparation in Implementation Project.
Involved in the cutover activities and Data migration Uploaded Master data through LSMW, BDC, and LTMC.
Expertise of Base line configuration of QM module.
Expertise in Quality planning, Quality Inspection, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates.
Having Experience in QM Processes like Source Inspection, Incoming, In process, Final, Delivery and Return Delivery Inspections.
Worked on SPC, Control Charts, and FMEA Process in QM Module.
Developed the WRICEF Objects in PM and QM Modules and prepared Functional Specification Document.
Worked on the Ticketing Tools BMC Remedy force, HPQC, Service Now.
Expertise in configuration and Mapping of Document Management System and Engineering Change Management.
Worked on Digital signature, DMS and Engineering Change Management.
Good Knowledge in SAP PS Module.
Expertise in performing Unit Testing, User Acceptance Testing, and Integration Testing by following quality standards.
Excellent skills in creating training documents and performing knowledge transfer and training to support teams.
Strong People Skills, Self-motivation, Co-ordination Skills as a collaborator and Individual contributor.
Strong desire to gain exposure to multiple industries and learning new skills and other SAP modules.
Experience in leading and mentoring technical teams for project deliverables and issues.
